questions.reveal: 0–5. Auburn won all five: 2007 (finished 9–4), 2010 (14–0), 2013 (12–2), 2017 (10–4) and 2019 (9–4). Against every other Auburn team, Saban's Alabama went 12–0.

questions.label: Iron Bowl
questions.prompt: Chris Davis returned Alabama's missed field goal for the 'Kick Six.' Was that field-goal attempt longer or shorter than
questions.reveal: Longer. Alabama tried a 57-yard field goal; it fell short and Chris Davis returned it 109 yards for the touchdown that won it 34–28.
